content.text: No exclusivity obligation binds Customer anywhere in the document; the agreement expressly disclaims one.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to engage any supplier, and confirms Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. Section 2.1 reinforces this with no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach or shortfall. Section 13.1 grants only a non-exclusive access right, and searches for sole-source, "all requirements", or third-party procurement restrictions returned nothing binding Customer. The only exclusivity-type restriction (Section 12.4, Vendor shall not market a directly competing analytics service) runs against Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. This meets the preferred position: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
